name: Verglas Curve

frame.name: Hail Barrage
frame.description: Final blows with this weapon grant Stasis arrows. Your next hip-fire shot will fire all of them in a single volley.

perks.name: Natural String
perks.description:
Simple balanced string.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Straight Fletching
perks.description:
Modern fletching for straight paths. 
  •  Increases accuracy

perks.name: Hail Storm
perks.description: Direct hits with Stasis arrows freeze combatants and slow opposing Guardians. Stasis arrows that impact the environment create Stasis crystals.

flavor: A volley of solutions to any disruption.

catalyst.name: Verglas Curve Catalyst
catalyst.description: Freezing or slowing a target grants this weapon faster draw speed for a short period of time.
